note: Real speech in which the speaker says 'DAPO' — a real RL algorithm — while the screen is full of GRPO, an equally real and similar-sounding one. Acronyms are the hardest near-miss: they are short, unstressed, phonetically close, and the model has strong priors about which ones exist. This is the case a dictionary-based tool fails worst, because both are plausible vocabulary entries. ASSERTION STRENGTHENED 2026-08-13: the note recorded that the speaker says DAPO but nothing asserted it, so a transcript naming no acronym at all passed. DAPO is demonstrably recoverable — xAI writes 'DAP-DAPo', which matches case-insensitively — while Mistral writes 'apu' and now correctly fails.

context.visibleText: GRPO computes the gradient over grouped rollouts. We use GRPO for the policy update. Compare GRPO against PPO on the same batch. The GRPO objective normalises within the group.
